parsed.visual_overview: A split-screen video. The top half shows a static AI robot teacher in an Indian living room, while the bottom half shows a live-action North Indian man driving a car. The man asks questions and practices English, and the video cuts to app screencasts when discussing price and features, ending with a smartphone CTA.

scenes.script_native:
Rahul says: मुझे आज एक tourist से बात करनी है। कैसे start करूँ?
Miss Nova says: अगर कोई tourist आये, तो कहिए, "Welcome. Where would you like to go?"
Rahul says: Welcome. Where would you like to go?
scenes.script_roman:
Rahul says: Mujhe aaj ek tourist se baat karni hai. Kaise start karoon?
Miss Nova says: Agar koi tourist aaye, toh kahiye, "Welcome. Where would you like to go?"
Rahul says: Welcome. Where would you like to go?

scenes.script_native:
Rahul says: ये तो बहुत easy है। मैं English कैसे सीखूँ?
Miss Nova says: बस मेरे साथ daily 10-15 minutes speaking practice कीजिए। आप 30 days में ही improve कर लेंगे।
scenes.script_roman:
Rahul says: Ye toh bahut easy hai. Main English kaise seekhoon?
Miss Nova says: Bas mere saath daily 10-15 minutes speaking practice kijiye. Aap 30 days mein hi improve kar lenge.

scenes.script_native:
Rahul says: पर ये सब बहुत expensive होगा ना?
Miss Nova says: बिलकुल नहीं, ये offline coaching से saat guna sasta है। और 1 crore+ users पहले से ही मेरे साथ English सीख रहे हैं।
scenes.script_roman:
Rahul says: Par ye sab bahut expensive hoga na?
Miss Nova says: Bilkul nahi, ye offline coaching se saat guna sasta hai. Aur 1 crore+ users pehle se hi mere saath English seekh rahe hain.

scenes.script_native: Rahul says: Awesome! मैं join कैसे करूँ?
scenes.script_roman: Rahul says: Awesome! Main join kaise karoon?

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: अभी Supernova AI app download कीजिए और अपनी English practice शुरू कीजिए।
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Abhi Supernova AI app download kijiye aur apni English practice shuru kijiye.

pitch_points_used: Time is not the blocker (10-15 minutes)
